caption: The drawing depicts a single blue vessel centered on a plain, beige background. The vessel is cylindrical with a slightly flared base and a flat top. Its surface features two symmetrical protruding spouts or handles opposite each other. The rim of the top is decorated with several concentric horizontal ridges. The vessel is entirely rendered in varying shades of blue, providing a sense of depth and dimensionality. The base of the vessel has a circular shape and appears shaded to indicate roundness. At the bottom right of the image, the name "JOHN DAMA" is written in small, uppercase letters. There is a faint, straight horizontal line with short vertical lines at each end located in the bottom left corner, resembling a scale or measurement indicator. The background remains unadorned and monochromatic, emphasizing the blue vessel as the sole subject of the composition.
title: Bowl
